note: A DATED, bundled snapshot of PUBLIC, open-licensed known-bad addresses. The node screens against this LOCALLY — no hosted oracle is needed for the hard block, so a known-bad address is refused even when every service is down. This is a small SEED (refresh/expand via scripts/biii-known-bad-ingest.js against the sources below). It is re-verifiable: anyone can check these against the named public lists. Absence of an entry is NOT a clean verdict.
